==Purpose of template==
This template can be added to dubious - ''but not '''obviously''' wrong'' - information in wiki pages. 

==How to use==
Adding <code><nowiki>{{dubious}}</nowiki></code> is all that is needed. However if you put a <code><nowiki>|<date></nowiki></code> parameter after it, you will yield a datestamp that can be useful to know how long something has been under consideration. Adding a <code><nowiki>|text</nowiki></code> after that adds custom text.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{dubious}}</nowiki></code>
{{dubious}}

<code><nowiki>{{dubious|Oct 2024}}</nowiki></code>
{{dubious|Oct 2024}}

<code><nowiki>{{dubious|Oct 17 1948}}</nowiki></code>
{{dubious|Oct 17 1948}}

<code><nowiki>{{dubious|Oct 17 1948|Lorem ipsum}}</nowiki></code>
{{dubious|Oct 17 1948|Lorem ipsum}}

<code><nowiki>{{dubious||Lorem ipsum}}</nowiki></code>
{{dubious||Lorem ipsum}}
